description: How the per-unit price moves with quantity for a quote you already have: for every shop on the board, the item price per unit at each quantity (default 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000; pass up to 16 of your own in 1..10000) from that shop's own pricing with the network's markup included, plus its arrival window — instant, no shop is contacted, nothing changes on the quote. Call it when the user asks what more or fewer pieces would cost ("what would 50 run me?", "any price breaks?"). The board's quoted price stays the ceiling at the chosen quantity (each option's `live` row); a null cell means that shop's pricing does not cover that quantity — refine_quote with the new quantities gets the real number. Present these as the shops' own pricing, never as an estimate; every order still passes the manufacturability check.
